findings.location: social_results.tex s conduct-framing heading 'Misleading framing'; abstract 'a misleading omission'
findings.claim: The G13 omission concerns the seller's own outside option (mortgaging own collateral), i.e., reservation concealment, which conventional negotiation norms treat differently from false factual assertion; the case's distinctiveness is the speaker's self-labelled 'slightly deceptive' rationale.
findings.evidence: d252 note and reasoning; ABA Model Rule 4.1 cmt [2] (2004 Model comment) as reproduced on courtrules.net NH page -- primary ABA page returned 403, so verification is secondary.
findings.resolution: Declare a taxonomy: false factual assertion / non-disclosure of own options / posture; classify each chronology.
